fightSong.title: Gator Bait
fightSong.lyrics: Deep in the swamp where the gators lie / Jacksonville's coming, watch us fly / Murky water, clear intent / Swamp football, 100 percent!

stadium.name: The Bog
stadium.tradition: The Chomp — a 30-foot inflatable gator chomps pre-game. If it gets stuck, we lose. It's gotten stuck a lot.

fanCulture.description: They wear camo to games. After sacks they do the gator chomp. It's humid, it's buggy, it's home.
fanCulture.tailgate: With a pool in the parking lot (seriously).

rivalries.name: The Swamp vs Sun
rivalries.narrative: North Florida vs South Florida. Different worlds.

cityFlavor: Biggest city by area, smallest ego. We like it swampy.
